product.title: La9odam Modern Sports Shoe
product.description: Experience comfort and style with La9odam – a sleek, lightweight, and durable design built to keep you moving forward. Perfect for everyday wear and athletic performance.

story.title: In a world crowded with overdesigned footwear and loud marketing that tries too hard, we chose to go back in time.
story.intro: Back to authenticity, fairness, and the kind of simplicity that speaks for itself.
story.collaboration: We brought back a design that has always been a symbol of Shaolin strength — the shoe worn by kung fu masters, seen in Shaolin temples, on global stages, and at the Olympics.
story.qualities: A timeless design that never ages… made from simple materials that proved to be comfortable, light, and durable. A reminder that the things made without show-off are the ones that truly last.
story.message: And we worked with the original factory — the one that lost the rights to its own creation because of an unfair legal battle — and decided to help return what was taken from them. Because fairness matters, and craft deserves to stay with the hands that built it.
story.learnMore: Learn more about Lqdam… and about Dafu, the factory that started the story

philosophy.intro: From the streets of Shanghai and the Shaolin Temples in Henan, China, our inspiration began. We revived a design that has proven itself for over a century.
philosophy.design: And in collaboration with the original manufacturer, the Dafu Rubber Company in Shanghai, we built Lqdam: a shoe made with a natural canvas upper and a rubber sole.
philosophy.simplicity: Every pair carries the same spirit as the original — flexible, steady, and made for movement. Lqdam is light, comfortable, and built to last, designed to provide lasting comfort, simply, without complexity, and at a fair price.
philosophy.collaboration: Lqdam, which means Leap Forward in Arabic, is a movement and a voice we want everyone to hear. A message that says: what’s right should return to its people, and you should stand bold, stay unafraid… always moving forward.
